right_target.location: Statement opening parenthetical; Facts F1–F2; Verification 1.1
right_target.evidence: The Statement names the pentagon and y²=x⁵−1 as instances, but F1 only gives genus two and F2 takes H₁(X;ℤ)=A·C as Given. The current thm-symplectic-homology-basis supplier establishes a basis for a generic one-polygon model; it does not construct the orbit C for this curve or prove that its orbit is an integral basis. McMullen p. 128 says “Using the pentagon picture, one can easily show” this, but gives no computation; SCHEMA.md says a citation does not replace a proof. The local conditional calculation therefore does not establish its named witness. [McMullen p. 128](https://people.math.harvard.edu/~ctm/papers/home/text/class/harvard/213b/course/course.pdf)
